response.sql:
WITH filtered_telescopes AS (
  SELECT 
    t.bandusagepct,
    o.weathprofile
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1
),
profile_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    weathprofile,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM filtered_telescopes
  GROUP BY weathprofile
),
mean_of_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as mean_avg
  FROM profile_averages
  WHERE avg_bandwidth IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  pa.weathprofile,
  pa.avg_bandwidth,
  pa.telescope_count,
  pa.avg_bandwidth - ma.mean_avg as deviation_from_mean
FROM profile_averages pa
CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages ma
WHERE pa.avg_bandwidth IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pa.weathprofile;

assumptions.assumption: "High side of a 152.1 cutoff" means detecttempk >= 152.1, not > 152.1. The phrase could reasonably mean either, but >= is the standard interpretation of being "on the high side" of a threshold.

alternatives.interpretation: If "high side of a 152.1 cutoff" means strictly greater than (>) rather than greater than or equal to (>=)
